items.title: Leagues are live!
items.summary: League System Added a new competitive system – Leagues, available only for Seasonal characters. After your first raid, you'll be placed into a group of 50 players of your rank. Each group has its own leaderboard. Your position on the leaderboard is determined by the amount of experience you've earned during the week.
